roles.planner: Defines mission, scope, files, commands, tests, pass/fail, stop condition, return schema, and commit permission.
roles.generator: Implements only inside allowed scope and reports exact outputs.
roles.evaluator: Verifies evidence, tests, diffs, safety status, and verdict.

verdict_definitions.PASS: All required artifacts exist, tests pass, forbidden files clean, safety gates active, evidence supports verdict.
verdict_definitions.PARTIAL: Useful work exists but non-critical requirements remain incomplete. No promotion allowed.
verdict_definitions.BLOCKED: Work cannot proceed because preflight, safety, credentials, or source availability failed.
verdict_definitions.FAIL: Safety rules were violated or evidence did not support claims.

commit_rules: forbidden files must not be staged
